# ADR-3095: A08: Documented unsigned internal package for lab 11

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Labs move faster with fewer gates.

## Decision

Labs MAY adopt a documented unsigned internal package for lab 11 (A08-11) when prototyping throwaway tooling.

## Consequences

Unsigned packages is expected to promote to prod.
